title: Luxury Waterfront Villa
description: Contemporary waterfront home with stunning ocean views. Features open-concept living with floor-to-ceiling windows. Gourmet kitchen with premium appliances. Master suite with spa bathroom. Private pool and outdoor entertainment area. Smart home technology throughout.

title: Modern Downtown Condo
description: Stunning high-rise condo in the heart of downtown Austin. Features modern finishes throughout with hardwood floors and quartz countertops. Building amenities include state-of-the-art fitness center and rooftop pool with city views. Walking distance to restaurants and entertainment.

title: Spacious Family Home
description: Perfect family home in quiet neighborhood. Spacious layout with formal living and dining rooms. Updated kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances. Finished basement provides extra living space. Large backyard backs to open space with mountain views.

title: Beachfront Paradise
amenities: private beach access;pool;hot tub;outdoor kitchen;wine cellar
description: Spectacular beachfront estate with direct ocean access. Designer finishes throughout including marble floors and custom millwork. Chef's kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances. Master retreat with ocean views. Resort-style backyard with infinity pool.

title: Urban Loft
description: Trendy loft in converted warehouse. Features exposed brick walls and 14-foot ceilings. Open floor plan with modern kitchen. Large windows flood space with natural light. Prime downtown location near tech companies and nightlife.

title: Mountain Retreat
description: Stunning mountain home on 2 acres. Vaulted ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows showcase incredible views. Gourmet kitchen with granite island. Large deck perfect for entertaining. Close to hiking and skiing.

title: Luxury Penthouse
description: Rare penthouse opportunity in prestigious Brickell tower. 360-degree views of bay and ocean. Private elevator entry. Italian marble throughout. Smart home automation. Two parking spaces and storage.

title: Hill Country Estate
description: Magnificent Hill Country estate on 20 acres. Main house plus guest house. Resort-style pool and spa. Lighted tennis court. Barn and paddocks for horses. Panoramic views and complete privacy.

title: Cozy Craftsman
amenities: hardwood floors;front porch;updated kitchen;walk to shops;fenced yard
description: Charming craftsman bungalow in walkable neighborhood. Original hardwood floors and built-ins. Updated kitchen with white cabinets. Covered front porch. Fenced backyard with mature trees. Close to parks and restaurants.

title: Art Deco Gem
description: Beautifully updated unit in iconic Art Deco building. Maintains period charm while offering modern amenities. Open kitchen with stainless appliances. Balcony overlooks ocean. Steps to beach and South Beach nightlife.

title: Tech Worker Special
amenities: near tech campus;pool;gym;work from home office;pet friendly
description: Perfect for tech professionals. Located near major tech campuses. Modern finishes with dedicated office space. Building amenities include pool and 24-hour gym. Pet-friendly with dog park on-site.

title: Golf Course Living
amenities: golf course views;clubhouse access;upgraded kitchen;3-car garage;patio
description: Premier golf course community home. Backs to 18th fairway with mountain backdrop. Gourmet kitchen with Viking appliances. Main floor master suite. Oversized 3-car garage. Club membership available.

title: Investor Opportunity
description: Great investment property in up-and-coming neighborhood. Recently renovated with modern finishes. Strong rental history. Low HOA fees. Walking distance to beach and Wynwood Arts District.

title: Lake Travis Oasis
description: Stunning Lake Travis waterfront home. Private boat dock and lake access. Infinity pool overlooking water. Multiple outdoor living spaces. Gourmet kitchen opens to great room. Master suite with lake views.

title: Downtown Walkable
description: Modern townhome in heart of downtown. Walk to work and entertainment. Open concept main floor. Rooftop deck with city and mountain views. Attached 2-car garage. Light rail station two blocks away.

title: Coral Gables Classic
description: Mediterranean-style home in prestigious Coral Gables. Original architectural details with modern updates. Chef's kitchen with butler's pantry. Saltwater pool surrounded by lush tropical landscaping. Separate guest suite.

title: Barton Creek Beauty
description: Sophisticated home near Barton Creek Greenbelt. Completely renovated with designer finishes. Home office with built-ins. Large deck perfect for entertaining. Direct access to hiking and biking trails.

title: Cherry Creek Charm
description: Elegant home in Denver's most desirable neighborhood. Walking distance to Cherry Creek shopping and dining. Hardwood floors throughout. Updated kitchen with marble counters. Private backyard with covered patio.

title: Starter Home Deal
description: Perfect starter home or investment. Updated kitchen and bathroom. Community pool and recreation area. Near Metrorail for easy commuting. Low HOA fees. Move-in ready condition.

title: New Construction Modern
description: Brand new construction in trendy Rainey Street district. Modern design with high-end finishes. Energy efficient with smart home features. Private rooftop terrace. Walk to bars and restaurants. Builder warranty included.
